truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 found 14 of the 20 true vulnerabilities fully, 1 partially, and missed 5. It frequently underclaimed severity and misassigned CWEs, while also overclaiming severity on several confirmed vulnerabilities. It missed path traversal, thread-unsafe timestamp cache, persistent authentication state, TOCTOU, and the memory-pool integer underflow.

Items.Notes: The audited answer explicitly identified runtime_log_format() being passed to printf with user_input and traced the format from config log_format.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Factorial can cause denial of service or signed integer overflow
Items.Notes: It quoted the fact lambda and the result *= i multiplication, matching the integer overflow truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free and data race when global memory pool is cleaned up before thread pool tasks complete
Items.Notes: It identified stage_deferred_history_flush enqueuing raw scratch pool pointers and g_memory_pool.cleanup freeing them without stopping/joining workers. It omitted explicit sleep_for evidence, but the use-after-free was present.
It quoted validator_cmd + config_file and system(command.c_str()) and linked the trigger to admin validate.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Inverted bounds check causes stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: It found the strcpy(input_buffer_) inverted bounds check and separately found the safe_string_copy off-by-one involving dest[src_len] and src_len > dest_size. It overclaimed the primary item as Critical.
It quoted volatile long long value_, old_value = value_ before lock, and value_ = old_value + 1, matching the race.
It quoted login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ = true. It misclassified the CWE and overclaimed severity.
No finding identified config_dir_ + filename or load_config(filename) as a path traversal weakness.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unbounded strcpy into fixed 256-byte parser expression buffer
Items.Notes: It quoted buffer_size_ = 256, strcpy into expression_buffer_, and the schedule_expression_analysis path. It underclaimed severity and used a non-heap CWE.
It directly identified ADMIN_SECRET as SC_ENT_2025_AUTH.
It quoted std::mt19937, uniform_int_distribution, and the 1000 to 9999 range. It underclaimed severity and used CWE-330 instead of CWE-338.
No finding identified the thread-unsafe static cached_time and localtime update in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Shell injection via environment-controlled temp path in override audit logging
Items.Notes: It found system() with environment-controlled TMPDIR and supercalc_emergency.log, but framed it as command injection and did not identify the insecure temporary file handling weakness or explicitly cite the TEMP branch.
No finding identified persistent authentication state involving authenticated_, session_token_, and login_attempts_.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Uncaught std::stod exception in variable set command can terminate the program
Items.Notes: It identified std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command and the uncaught exception impact.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: one latent memory-pool overlap finding was dropped because the split allocator does not show overlapping live allocations
Items.Notes: The audited answer did not report the integer underflow in the block split path and asserted an unsupported reason for dropping it.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unbounded recursive parsing of nested parentheses
Items.Notes: It identified PAREN_OPEN recursion between parse_factor and parse_expression and the lack of enforced recursion depth. It underclaimed severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race on unsynchronized result cache in ExpressionEvaluator
Items.Notes: It identified result_cache_ accessed in evaluate_cached without cache_mutex_ despite threaded execution. It overclaimed severity as High.
No finding identified the exists check, sleep_for, and later ifstream open in load_config as a TOCTOU issue.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: It identified 100 / token_length with token_length possibly zero. It overclaimed severity as Medium.
